title: Screen blackouts and multiple-system faults
summary: This topic centers on screen blackouts, system shutdowns, and other unrelated issues grouped by words like “completely” and “multiple,” with many examples lacking clear sentiment.

positive.summary: One review expresses overall satisfaction with the car rather than a specific screen or system issue.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention the screen going completely black, frustration with navigating multiple screens, and multiple bus-system faults occurring at once.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples mention screen blanking, powering down, update-related screen misbehavior, accuracy concerns, a broken windshield, and clean sensor surfaces without enough context to assign clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: The topic cluster mixes related screen and power-down issues with unrelated items such as windshield damage, sensor cleanliness, and a vague accuracy comment.
Many fragments are too short or lack context, so the dominant customer stance is unclear for much of the sample.
The examples are stratified samples and are not representative estimates of issue frequency or defect rates.
